title: 第7章 天才第8章 蠢货第9章 沐浴
content_zh:
看著四周被剑气破坏的痕跡，夏紫萱美眸中惊喜连连。
寻常武者可练不出剑气。
只有领悟剑意后，才能驾驭住剑气的锋芒。
楚夏看著年纪不大，修为也不高，却能够將剑气发挥到如此境地，这肯定是从小磨礪打熬的结果。
可他才多大啊。
总不能从娘胎里就开始练习剑法吧。
这就是真正的天才吧！
双胞胎更是惊嘆不已，看向楚夏的眼神都多了几分崇拜之意。
“我修炼了多久？”楚夏起身问道。
“已经过去两天了。”夏紫萱道。
已经两天了嘛？
楚夏竟然毫无感觉，仿佛只过去了一剎。
不愧是修仙功法，玄妙至极，让人一沉浸就完全忘却了时间流逝。
“距离试炼结束还有多久？”
“只剩不到半天了。”
（请记住101??????.??????网站，观看最快的章节更新）
说到这，夏紫萱神色再次凝重起来。
虽然已经闯过两关，但最后一关才是最艰难的。
这两天她已经尝试了多次，然而看不到半点成功的希望。
现在楚夏醒来，或许只能指望他来创造奇蹟了。

夏紫萱眼神里满含期待的看著楚夏：“跟我来，我给你讲解一下最后一关的情况。”
“好。”
楚夏跟隨过去，穿过长长的地道，来到了最深处的地下室。
地下室四面环水，中间是一个直径超过二十米的圆形平台。
平台由漆黑坚硬的乌铁打造而成，上面有很多密密麻麻的孔洞。
在平台的中心位置，摆放著一张石桌，石桌上有一个木盒子。
“那就是武祖殿试炼的奖励，修仙功法【五行术】。”
“修仙功法？”
楚夏眉头一皱。
不知道是什么品级。
但万神鼎似乎没有任何反应。
难道是瞧不上？
content_en:
Looking at the traces of damage caused by the sword energy all around, Xia Zixuan's beautiful eyes were full of surprises.
Ordinary warriors cannot practice sword energy.
Only after understanding the sword's intention can one control the edge of the sword's energy.
It seems that Chu Xia is not very old and her cultivation level is not high, but she is able to exert her sword energy to such a level. This must be the result of hard work since childhood.
But how old is he?
You can't just start practicing swordsmanship from your mother's womb.
This is true genius!
The twins were even more amazed, looking at Chu Xia with a bit more admiration.
"How long have I been practicing?" Chu Xia stood up and asked.
"Two days have passed." Xia Zixuan said.
Has it been two days?
Chu Xia felt nothing at all, as if only a moment had passed.
It is truly an immortal cultivation technique, it is so mysterious that one can completely forget the passage of time once one is immersed in it.
"How long until the trial ends?"
"There's less than half a day left."
(Please remember the 101??????.?????? website to watch the fastest chapter updates)
Speaking of this, Xia Zixuan's expression became solemn again.
Although I have passed two levels, the last level is the most difficult.
She has tried many times in the past two days, but there is no hope of success.
Now that Chu Xia wakes up, perhaps she can only count on him to create miracles.
Xia Zixuan looked at Chu Xia with expectant eyes: "Come with me, I will explain to you the situation of the last level."
"Okay."
Chu Xia followed and walked through the long tunnel to the deepest basement.
The basement is surrounded by water, and in the middle is a circular platform with a diameter of more than twenty meters.
The platform is made of pitch black and hard black iron, with many dense holes on it.
In the center of the platform, there is a stone table with a wooden box on it.
"That is the reward for the Martial Ancestor Hall trial, the Immortal Cultivation Technique [Five Elements Technique]."
"Cultivation skills?"
Chu Xia frowned.
Don't know what grade it is.
But the Ten Thousand God Cauldron seemed to have no reaction.
Is it because you don’t like it?
